metadata.purpose: Repeat source after successful completion up to a total source-subscription count.

conditions: count=0 produces no source subscription and only successful empty completion.
Each source success except the final causes a fresh source subscription.
An error terminates the result; values across all completed attempts remain delivered.

scope.parameters: Finite safe-integer bound in 0..8. Total subscriptions including the initial one.
scope.callbacks: No notifier callback or delay selector in this profile.
scope.time: Resubscription is immediate following source terminal delivery. Time of later notifications belongs to each new producer.
scope.reentrancy: Nonreentrant, post-setup notifications; only bounded finite runs.
exclusions: Unbounded (Infinity), fractional/negative counts, numeric or notifier-function delays and scheduler-driven resubscription.
Synchronous terminal notifications during subscription setup, reentrant observers and teardown exceptions.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Acquire one source generation 0 at first downstream subscription.

ownership.sharing: None: each result subscription independently executes and restarts source.
ownership.reset: New result subscription resets generation, attempts and error counter.

resources.owner: current attempt; generation increments on restart

dispatch.actionSemantics: Terminal source event may dispose the current generation then subscribe the next; actions are ordered within a transition.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between source notifications and after every restarted source acquisition.

controls.description: one active source generation with restart counters
